set.body:
Type: implementation task
Work key: CX05.2
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: The lineage strip shows release ids and dates only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Each lineage entry shows the acceptance reason (truncated, full on focus/hover) and a "Changes" view listing files added/changed/removed versus the parent, computed from the two inventories.
2. Findings introduced or resolved by the release are listed with links.
3. Demo transport mirrors the new fields; behaviour probes cover correction and import releases.

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`. Plus `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js (lineage, releaseView)
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/demo.js
set.title: CX05.2: Show reasons and changes in the release lineage
